tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: Search the catalog of 246 Indian public APIs by keyword, domain, access tier or auth method.

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: Get full metadata for one API by its ID (e.g. IN-API-0001).

tools.name: pincode_lookup
tools.description: Look up post offices, district and state for an Indian 6-digit PIN code (India Post data).

tools.name: ifsc_lookup
tools.description: Resolve an Indian bank IFSC code to bank, branch, address and supported rails.

tools.name: digipin_encode
tools.description: Encode latitude/longitude into India Post's 10-character DIGIPIN (computed locally).

tools.name: digipin_decode
tools.description: Decode a DIGIPIN back to the centre latitude/longitude of its ~4m grid cell.

tools.name: ogd_dataset_query
tools.description: Query any data.gov.in OGD resource by resource_id (cached 6h, 500 uncached calls/day cap).

tools.name: mandi_prices
tools.description: Current daily mandi (Agmarknet) commodity prices via data.gov.in.
